headline: The Planning Board opened review of a proposed Costco warehouse and gas station, while town boards prepared warrant articles for Special Town Meeting.
synopsis: The Planning Board opened public hearings on a proposal to build a 167,000-square-foot Costco warehouse and 15-pump fueling station on Coslin Drive, drawing questions about traffic and neighborhood impacts. Ahead of the October 17 Special Town Meeting, both the Planning Board and Trails Committee weighed strategies for warrant articles on two-family zoning regulations and Peninsula Trail bridge funding. The Trails Committee also organized fall community events, safety precautions for youth hunting season, and outreach for Heritage Day.

highlights.title: Costco wholesale warehouse and fuel station proposal
highlights.why: Costco presented plans for a 167,000-square-foot store and a 15-pump gas station spanning Southborough and Westborough at 21 Coslin Drive. Board members and residents raised concerns about traffic congestion, regional cut-throughs, and loading dock noise before the hearing was continued to October 19.

highlights.title: Peninsula Trail bridge Town Meeting funding strategy
highlights.why: Facing non-recommendation votes from the Select Board and Advisory Committee on Article 4, the Trails Committee discussed a fallback amendment to repurpose $211,000 in existing CPA funds and request $25,000 in new funds for a pedestrian bridge. Members debated how to present the plan and address arguments over prioritizing athletic fields.

highlights.title: Two-family dwelling zoning warrant article
highlights.why: The Planning Board continued its hearing on a warrant article clarifying two-family zoning rules after questions arose about whether current text could unintentionally allow smaller commercial lots to be used for two-family homes. The board continued the hearing to October 17 just prior to Town Meeting.

highlights.title: Master Plan 2030 preparations
highlights.why: The board reviewed recommendations to form a sub-committee in 2027 and pursue consultant funding in FY28 to prepare Southborough's next 10-year comprehensive plan. A joint meeting with the Master Plan Implementation Committee is scheduled for October 19.

highlights.title: Fall trail events and youth hunting season safety
highlights.why: The Trails Committee confirmed details for guided trail yoga and hikes while advising participants to wear blaze orange vests due to youth hunting season opening. The committee also began organizing a November trail run and food pantry drive.

looking_ahead.what: Multi-board meeting on elementary school building options
Pre-Town Meeting meeting and continued hearing on two-family dwelling warrant article
